reason: The free first visit is a no-risk way to see it, and a place to sit with coffee while the toddler plays is appealing on my work-from-home days. But we'd realistically go once or twice a month, so I'd pay drop-in and never a membership.
objection: At $38k a year, $15 a visit adds up fast and we'd go once or twice a month, not enough to justify a membership. I also wonder if the Wi-Fi and seating are good enough to actually get work done.
would_change_my_mind: A cheaper drop-in around $10-12, or a pack priced low enough that two or three visits a month feels okay.
